_readme: The Kashkoul family of sites. tools/build.js turns this list into the house strip, the mobile-menu block and the footer doors on every site; market/tools/sync-house.mjs does the same for the Market's Shopify theme (which lives on its own domain, so it prefixes paths with origin). To launch a site: set its status to "live". newTab: open the other sites in a new tab. blurb_ar: the Arabic blurb, used by the Market.

sites.blurb: The rooms, rented by the hour or the day
Instruments and art supplies, sourced for you
